text: The European Commission fined Google under the Digital Markets Act and issued compliance requirements concerning search result presentation and Google Play distribution practices. Google stated it was evaluating an appeal while implementing and testing changes identified by the Commission. The regulatory order remained in effect.

meta.note: The appeal process and future compliance outcome remain separate from the present regulatory configuration.

text: U.S. Treasury yields rose across maturities, with the 10-year yield reaching its highest level since January 2025. Government bond yields also increased in other major markets. Yield adjustments occurred across sovereign debt markets while benchmark rates remained concentrated at higher levels.

meta.note: Commodity prices and economic data are excluded because the entry captures the observed bond market configuration only.

text: Reported attacks targeted Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea following a declared maritime embargo. Commercial energy shipping in the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz remained under active military and security conditions. Maritime transport routes for oil were subject to concurrent physical disruption and contested access.

meta.note: Price movements and stated military responses are excluded because the entry records the observed transport configuration only.

text: Alphabet and Tesla reported increased capital expenditures directed toward AI-related infrastructure while both reported negative free cash flow. Investment remained focused on compute capacity, semiconductor manufacturing, and AI production infrastructure. Equity prices adjusted while announced capital allocation remained unchanged.

meta.note: Equity price movement and capital allocation are recorded as coexisting conditions without implying causation.

text: Google Cloud stated that customer demand exceeded available internal capacity and that third-party cloud infrastructure would be used temporarily while internal capcity expanded. Existing customers increased consumption beyond committed levels. AI service delivery remained distributed across internal and external compute resources.

meta.note: Customer spending levels and infrastructure sourcing are captured separately from financial market reactions.

text: Intel reported demand for server processors exceeding available supply and stated it is increasing capital expenditures for manufacturing capacity. The company expanded long-term CPU supply agreements with customers while foundry investment continued. AI-related compute demand remained concentrated in data center infrastructure.

meta.note: Reported earnings and share price movements are excluded because the entry captures the infrastructure and supply configuration only.

text: Section 301 tariffs covering 60 trade partners were scheduled to take effect as Section 122 global tariffs expired. The new duties applied to most U.S. trade with the identified economies and operated under a different statutory authority. The tariff regime continued through a revised legal framework.

meta.note: The entry records the contemporaneous legal transition between tariff authorities, not future trade effects.
